title: Kasei-san MiniMax H3 ComfyUI workflow measurements on RTX 5060 Ti 16GB
claims: Author machine is RTX 5060 Ti 16GB, RAM 32GB, Windows 10, PCIe 3.0 x8; workflow uses ComfyUI, official pruned INT8 ConvRot DiT, NVFP4 text encoder and official VAEs.
T2V 1024x576 about 5.2 s: Turbo 171.6 s versus normal 379.2 s; I2V 0.6 MP: Turbo 207.7 s versus normal 704.4 s.
Fixed-seed 864x480/124-frame/20-step comparison reports no acceleration 270.9 s, EasyCache 210.7 s with noisy audio, Turbo 4 steps 117.6 s and Turbo 6 steps 114.4 s.
The author reports RSS reduction from 21.5 GB to 6.9 GB with --disable-pinned-memory and warns Turbo/EasyCache have different motion/audio behavior.

resources.workflow: ComfyUI flat workflow; Turbo LoRA toggle

limitations: Single author setup; not L4/A100; the fixed-seed comparison is within the author's graph and does not establish cross-quant quality.

title: GenVidKit local H3 ledger on RTX 3060 12GB
claims: Two-run measurements use RTX 3060 12GB, 47.05 GiB VM RAM, no swap, ComfyUI 0.31.0, PyTorch 2.13.0+cu130, fixed seed, 1344x768, 124 frames, 20 steps, res_multistep/simple.
System memory was 43587–43910 MiB across runs. The author states the three task rows are not a controlled task comparison because dates, inputs, graph and audio state differ.

resources.precision: Comfy-Org native H3 files; exact model filenames recorded in workflow

limitations: Not target L4/A100; task rows are explicitly non-controlled across task types, though each row has two raw runs and fixed seed.

title: Reddit H3 plus LTX 2.3 spatial upscale workflow
claims: Author reports RTX 4080 Super 16GB and RAM 64GB, standard ComfyUI H3 I2V followed by LTX 2.3 spatial upscale; Pastebin workflow is public.
H3 736x736, 0.5 MP, 5 s, 20 steps took about 3:25; LTX 2.3 3-step x2 upscale took about 2:05.
limitations: No fixed seed, quant file names, peak RAM or quality metric; two-stage timing is not a quant comparison.

title: Reddit H3 INT8 plus LTX 2.3 and RTX VSR to 2K
claims: Author reports RTX 4080 Super 16GB and RAM 64GB with ComfyUI template H3 INT8 T2V/R2V, LTX 2.3 spatial upscale, and Comfy RTX VSR nodes.
H3 INT8 0.7 MP/10 s about 12:40; LTX 2.3 x1.5 3:46; RTX VSR x1.5 under 10 s; total 2592x1440 output about 16 min; YouTube full-resolution artifact and workflows are linked.
limitations: Single user pipeline; no fixed seed/steps/frames; audio handling changes across LTX stages and is discussed in comments.

title: ai-muninn FastH3 V2 versus original H3 in ComfyUI
claims: Author uses RTX 5090 32GB, Windows, ComfyUI 0.37.0; FastH3 V2 and Trim share original H3 Qwen/VAE files. V2 keeps 50 blocks, Trim drops 8 blocks; VSA keeps 10% attention blocks.

Same first frame, same Mandarin line, 1344x768, 5 s/124 frames, warm, two seeds: FastH3 V2 8 steps 59.8/57.4 s; original pruned NVFP4 H3 20 steps 166.3/168.2 s and 10 steps 90.1/83.6 s. Times include text encode/decode/save.
At 832x480 T2V, V2 18.7/18.7 s and Trim 16.8/16.8 s; author used Whisper and says Mandarin was transcribed except the invented name.
On a modded 22 GB RTX 2080 Ti, VSA silently falls back because sm_75 lacks the sparse kernel; 832x480 Trim was 149.9 s on ComfyUI 0.31.
limitations: 5090/2080 Ti are conditional references only; author quality judgment is visual/Whisper based, not a metric; no L4/A100 result and no distilled Ref2VA test.

title: Author engineering test: 50 H3 clips on RTX 4090
claims: Raw MiniMaxAI weights path is FP8 diffusion plus NVFP4/AWQ text encoder on one RTX 4090; the article says 50 formal clips were checked across motion, dialogue, sports, hands/objects, text, resolution and duration, with local Whisper audio checks.
At 608x352, 5s/124 frames runtime 55.6 s and peak VRAM 41,546 MiB; 10s/244 frames 136.2 s/42,730 MiB; 20s/484 frames 353.0 s/46,250 MiB. 960x544 was 1452 s and 48,490 MiB.
The article reports recurring speech/audio, sports physics, hands/product topology and on-screen text failures in the test set; these are author observations, not a formal score.
limitations: Commercial/author site affiliation and exact prompt/seed ledger are not independently exposed; RTX 4090 raw-weight results do not establish L4/A100 behavior or GGUF quality. Main read confirms page explicitly labels 41,546–48,490 MiB as Peak VRAM while saying single RTX4090/24GB. These resource claims are internally inconsistent; no assumption that they mean RAM is made. Do not use this page to rank resource use or speed.
evidence_status: internally-inconsistent resource claims; excluded from usable benchmark evidence

title: WanGP/Wan2GP H3 integration, control paths and low-memory changelog
claims: WanGP lists support for Wan 2.1/2.2, MiniMax H3, LTX-2 and other families; it lists int8/fp8/GGUF/NVFP4 checkpoint formats and hardware-aware downloads.

The H3 changelog adds First Block Cache, Sol-Attn, lower-RAM VAE, W4A8 INT8 loading on compatible RTX 30+ cards, control video/depth/generic control, Ref2VA reference pixel budget, and quantized text-encoder selection.

Author release note says H3 can use 5–6 GB VRAM for 5s/124 frames and 8–9 GB for 15s at 832x480 in WanGP's optimized path, with 15–20 steps before distilled checkpoints; exact run ledger is not supplied.

resources.gpu: Hardware-dependent; changelog claims compatible NVIDIA/AMD paths
resources.workflow: WanGP/Wan2GP UI with H3 FL2VA or Ref2VA

limitations: Changelog claims are not a same-seed render ledger; low-VRAM numbers mix optimizers and offload modes, and no L4/A100 + High RAM run is specified. Main provenance: this URL is lucazin/Wan2GP, a derivative/fork snapshot. Canonical current project/README is recorded as INF18; claims here are not a canonical-release verification.

title: X search returned autogenerated trending summaries rather than original statuses
claims: Searches using MiniMax-H3, MiniMax H3, FastH3, quantization, VRAM, workflow and Japanese terms, with /i/ and trending exclusions, still returned x.com/i/trending summaries.

Summaries surfaced super_bonochin, TlanoAI, Kin no Niwatori and Hirokazu Yokohara/aigeboku as possible handles and mentioned 12GB or 6-to-2.5-minute claims, but no original status URL or complete conditions were readable.
limitations: Discovery lead only; autogenerated summaries are excluded from technical evidence.

title: Facebook public-group/post search boundary
claims: One broad pass used MiniMax H3/MiniMax-H3 with public model, workflow, ComfyUI, VRAM, time, FastH3 and L4 terms; returned results were unrelated, old, or login-gated.

No original H3/FastH3 public-group post with complete hardware, seed, model file and runtime conditions was readable without login; Bilibili indexing returned unrelated platform/old documents and Civitai hits were workflow indexes without readable test ledgers.
limitations: Search boundary only; absence in this checked scope is not evidence that Facebook has no H3 material.

The searchable result does not expose a reproducible prompt, seed, exact quant files, wall time or full hardware/RAM table.
